components.name: Steam Lance
components.blurb: Superheated water through a brass nozzle, rated for hulls and, regrettably, for the room it vents into. Keep a Mire on the hand-wheel; they have seen worse.
components.quirk: Heavy damage (+44% over a Laser Mk2), but each shot has a 10% chance to start a fire in its own room. Mire put fires out twice as fast and take half the burn.

components.name: Bog Mortar
components.blurb: Lobs a bucket of the swamp tank's best at the enemy hull. The paint comes off first, then the plating, then the argument.
components.quirk: Corrosive splash: the wall it hits takes 1.67x damage for 12 s, so the rest of your guns punch through. Slow shells, and a wet room: non-Mire crew work x0.8 beside it. Mire don't mind the damp.

components.name: Mist Projector
components.blurb: A cold fog from three brass nozzles that slows whatever it settles on. The gunners' boots never fully dry.
components.quirk: Frost: the system it hits charges 40% slower for 6 s. Its room gets wet: 30 less heat, and non-Mire crew work x0.8 in it. Mire are at home in a damp room.

components.name: Rain Shield
components.blurb: A curtain of falling water three layers deep. Fire marshals have noted the steam, and the marshals are right.
components.quirk: One layer more than a Shield Mk2 (three), but the vents start fires in its room (about one every 50 s). Mire put fires out twice as fast and take half the burn.

components.name: Wetwell Reactor
components.blurb: A core that runs under a foot of water for the extra output. Every inspector has asked, and every Mire has said it's fine.
components.quirk: +2 power over a Reactor Mk1, but a fire risk of 0.02 a second in its room. Mire put fires out twice as fast and take half the burn.

components.name: Spray Deck
components.blurb: Drain grate, four spray heads, one red hand-wheel. Puts the fire out and the floor under water. The floor was due a wash.
components.quirk: A sprinkler room: 30 less heat a second, so parts beside it run cool, and the floor floods a little (1% of the air a second). Non-Mire crew work x0.9 on the wet floor; Mire don't mind. The instant put-out every 30 s is not built yet.
